scope: Independent public edition/facsimile check of P4 proportion typography; no accepted evidence or source mutation.

authoritative_identity.title: To Asa Gray 5 September [1857]
authoritative_identity.source: Archives of the Gray Herbarium, Harvard University (48)

independent_witness.edition: Charles Darwin letters to Asa Gray, 1855-1881 (inclusive), transcript scan
independent_witness.repository: Internet Archive item charlesdarwinle00darw, contributed by Harvard University Botany Libraries

page_image.interpretation: The scanned printed transcript page visibly prints 881000, 501000, 481000 and 461000 without slash glyphs. It is a page-image of the independent edition/transcript, not a scan of Darwin's handwritten original.

independent_witness.printed_page_locator: PDF page 82 / scanned image n81; printed text continues from Life and Letters vol. I, pp. 477-482.
independent_witness.exact_independent_text: the large genera have 881000 varieties & the small genera only 501000 ... your vars. marked by big-type are only in proportion 481000 to 461000.
independent_witness.result: The independent printed transcript corroborates the same four digit strings and does not restore slash or fraction-bar typography. It therefore cannot resolve whether the intended manuscript displayed 88/1000, 50/1000, 48/1000 and 46/1000; those slash forms remain a separately normalized interpretation, not literal evidence from this witness.

additional_darwin_online_comparator.scope: Related Darwin statistics manuscript, not an independent witness to the 2136 letter. Its explanatory text says fractions are reduced to a common denominator of a thousand and its table uses explicit slash forms such as 112/1136 = 98/1000, but it does not reproduce the four P4 values from 2136.

facsimile_finding: No public scan of the original Harvard Gray Herbarium letter itself was located. DCP's accessible record provides the transcript; the independent IA/BHL witness is a printed transcript scan. Do not claim either resolves the handwritten original's fraction typography.
boundary: No slash values are admitted as literal source text, no arithmetic correction is made, and no primary ledger or frozen raw file was changed.
